# OneThree Distribution

OneThree Distribution is a Warehousing and Storage company. Team One Three is a company that provides distribution services, including e:fulfilment and multi-channel management, product rework/repack/returns, managed service, warehousing and distribution, storage and transport, and warehouse layout/racking solutions. OneThree Distribution employs 16 people (+6.7% YoY, +1 person), founded in 2020. Headquartered in Birmingham, West Midlands, United Kingdom.

## About

The best 3PL distribution partner that you have never heard of (yet)... 😬

With over 20 years senior management experience, leading the supply, warehousing and distribution solutions for some of the UK’s largest and most recognizable brands. 

We are experts in:

Inbound ✅
Storage Solutions ✅
Pick/Pack Order Fulfilment ✅
Returns ✅
Product Re-Pack - Re-Work ✅

We can handle the biggest (or smallest) of jobs, and remove the headache of your logistical challenges. 

Check us out at www.teamonethree.co.uk for more information. Or to make an enquiry, go to enquiries@teamonethree.co.uk

results.text:
# Warehouse One Distribution

Warehouse One Distribution is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Warehouse One Distribution employs 24 people (+41.2% YoY, +7 people) and has an annual revenue of $5.3M. Headquartered in Winsford, England, United Kingdom, with presence in Canada.

## About

Warehouse One is a trading division of Amethyst Group Limited. We are a market leading contract logistics and supply chain specialist, providing flexible warehousing, storage and distribution solutions for a range of businesses and sectors. We work closely with our clients and their partners to provide a cost-effective, tailored solution that is designed to meet their specific business requirements.

Our services cover all aspects of logistics planning, control and supply chain process from collection through to final delivery. In many of our logistics contracts we have Warehouse One personnel based on site to deal with the day to day operations and to liaise directly with our customers, we also have a dedicated retail delivery fleet ensuring that we retain full control throughout the process.

We are part of Cathay Investments group

For more information, please contact us on Contact@WarehouseOne.co.uk
